reader_summary.overview: with Marc Andreessen (@pmarca), Ben Horowitz (@bhorowitz), and Stewart Butterfield (@stewart) A lot in technology -- and venture -- happens in decades. New cycles of technology come and go, including some secular shifts; a new generation of founders matures; and so much more changes. So when Andreessen Horowitz (dubbed with the numeronym "a16z") was founded a decade ago as of this month.

key_points.text: So when Andreessen Horowitz (dubbed with the numeronym "a16z") was founded a decade ago as of this month.
Now, 10 years later, what's changed -- not just in tech, but in profiles of entrepreneurs?
And what's changed in the firm itself.
